parsed.impact: Described.meet changed from bool to Option<bool> and the prompt/schema changed: every description (US-10-02 adds, later US-10-04 changes) and the TC-10-18/19 test-set scoring depend on it; live guest accuracy dropped 97 % to 90 %. Editor gained `unresolved`, `pick` and `drop_unresolved`, and add_guest's Meet switch-on now meets description intent. sync.rs gained Job/Update::Named beside Suggest, and main.rs's reading flow now holds "Reading…" through a Google look-up and opens the editor from the update loop.

findings.text: crates/core/src/editor.rs:638 — "Lunch z Kasią jutro o 13 bez Meeta" with two contacts named Kasia: picking Kasia Lis goes through add_guest (editor.rs:603 `meet |= no guests yet`) and turns Meet on, so Save creates the Meet call the description refused (MOD-10-F07, criterion #3, DEC-223) → record in the editor that the description set Meet (flag set by described::fill when meet.is_some()), skip the first-guest switch-on in pick when set, and add a core test for refused Meet + pick

crates/core/src/described.rs:35 — the new Meet rule costs live guest accuracy: every field right 97 % to 90 % on gemma4:e4b ("Urodziny mamy…" now gets guest "mama" and opens the full editor; "Client call… no Meet" gets "client"); still above 80 % but a regression, and TC-10-19 was not re-run though Ollama was available → tune the guest rule and record the live score

crates/core/src/described_tests.rs:201 — the test-set score treats refused and not mentioned as the same, so a real-model null-vs-false regression (criterion #3) is invisible → record silent and refused separately and compare Option<bool>

crates/app/src/description_guests_tests.rs:352 — no app test saves with a name still unresolved (Zenek or "mama") to show nobody is invited; TC-10-22 removes it first → add a save with a name still listed

docs/specs/DECISIONS.md:2731 — DEC-226 defers greying out the Meet switch to the analyst but no QUESTIONS.md entry tracks it; the story edge case's literal "off and unavailable" is not built (accepted on its merits as the editor's current behaviour) → add the open question against MOD-06-F16/F17

crates/core/src/described.rs:180 — suggestions exclude guests invited by earlier names, so the outcome depends on the order of names (["Janek","Jan"] invites both automatically, ["Jan","Janek"] leaves Jan waiting with the already-invited Janek still suggested) and lists are not refreshed after a pick → filter out invited people when drawing (crates/app/src/editor.rs:285) and resolve against the guests before filling

crates/app/src/main.rs:2465 — the look-up result waits for no dialog to be open, so if the user opens another dialog during "Reading…", the described editor pops up when that dialog closes → drop the result, or keep it only while the box is still reading
crates/app/src/editor.rs:272 — the unresolved name drawn in warn_fg_color comes out blue in the light preview and looks like a link; for the owner's manual look
docs/specs/modules/10-events-from-a-description/stories/US-10-03-guests-and-meet.md:6 — story and BACKLOG row left at in-progress, not review (constitution definition of done)

criteria.note: "bez Meeta" does not keep Meet off once an uncertain name is picked: pick goes through add_guest's first-guest switch-on (B1); TC-10-23 only covers names resolved automatically
